sources.reason: spec-complete: the live WP-REST route index (GET /wp-json/wc/v3 -> 204 routes; GET /wp-json/wc/store/v1 -> 31 routes) is the server's own machine-readable route table with per-arg type/default/required/enum/description. It is definitionally the complete set of routes the API registers, and a superset of both the official docs (140 endpoint declarations) and every community spec (wtx-labs: 67 paths). No competitor or community project references any endpoint outside it, so the gap-detection heuristic does not fire. Browser capture of the storefront could only surface the Store API, which is already captured in full. Direct HTTP returned 200 with real JSON on both namespaces - no bot protection, challenge, or content-less shell was encountered at any point.
